def hat(x):
    M=np.zeros((len(x),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        left=knots[j-1] if j>0 else knots[0]-1e-9
        right=knots[j+1] if j<len(knots)-1 else knots[-1]+1e-9
